description: Exact-match, expiring third-party license exceptions for the V1.7 M5-C supply-chain gate. A non-empty exception must exactly identify the component (PURL preferred; otherwise exact name+version) AND the license/expression, plus owner, reason, mitigation/reviewCondition and expiresAt. Wildcard, broad, expired, duplicated and unused exceptions are rejected by supplychainlib. A license exception never invents missing metadata for a component that has none -- it only records an explicit allow for a specific component+license that the policy would otherwise deny/report-unknown/report-missing. Initially empty: no exceptions are granted without a real SBOM that requires one.
